title: AI-Face: A Million-Scale Demographically Annotated AI-Generated Face Dataset and Fairness Benchmark*
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking algorithmic fairness and demographic bias (skin tone, age, gender) within computer vision models for face detection. While fairness is a key pillar of AI ethics, the study utilizes technical and statistical metrics to measure bias rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious traditions, moral frameworks, or philosophical ethical systems.
